text:
Hiroshima and Miyajima really do fit in one day.
Start at 7:30, and check one table before you book 👇

👉 Save this, then see the full timings:
https://japanbystation.com/hiroshima-miyajima-one-day

1️⃣ Open the tide table first
Below 100 cm you can walk to the torii.
Above 250 cm it floats.
Choose the date, then the hotel.

2️⃣ Book the early museum slot
The Peace Memorial Museum opens at 7:30.
The first hour needs an online reservation.

3️⃣ Take JR, not the tram
About 25–30 minutes to Miyajimaguchi by JR,
against about 70–75 by tram.
That's an extra hour on the island.

4️⃣ Catch a JR ferry between 9:10 and 16:10
Those sailings pass close to the Great Torii.
Stand on the right-hand side, facing forward.

5️⃣ Keep ¥100 for the island
The visitor tax is in normal tickets and IC taps.
JR Pass holders buy it at the terminal.

👉 Where to stay for both tides:
https://japanbystation.com/hiroshima-miyajima-one-day

Which step would you have skipped without knowing? 😄
